description: Leave a comment on exactly ONE of an item, a ticket or an order — pass exactly one of itemId / ticketId / orderId plus the text ("note on the beamer: lamp flickers"). The comment appears in that record's activity timeline under your user's name marked "(via AI agent)", and notifies the involved people (item holder/responsible, ticket reporter/assignee, order participants). Order comments require being an order participant (requester, assignee or an order manager). @-mentions are not supported through this tool yet — plain text only. Read the conversation back with list_comments, which takes the same one target id — use it to check whether a question was already answered before adding another note, and to verify a comment you just posted. State the comment text and get your user's OK BEFORE calling. Not idempotent: a retry posts a second comment — after a timeout, read list_comments before retrying.
name: add_comment

viaAgent.description: True — the comment is marked as written via AI agent

title: Add comment
